scene.testo: [Moreira] among the worst of the weekend: he retired on lap 16.
[Moreira]: sixteenth in qualifying, tenth in the sprint and retired on lap 16. Grade *five*.
[Giannantonio]: third in qualifying, second in the sprint and eighth in the race, starting third. Today he gets *six and a half*.
[Martin]: eleventh in qualifying, third in the sprint and seventh in the race, starting eleventh. He earns *six and a half*.
[Fernandez]: fourth in qualifying, fourth in the sprint and third in the race. We give him *eight*.
[Marc Marquez]: second in qualifying, first in the sprint and second in the race. Grade *nine*.
And then the best: [Bezzecchi]. First in qualifying, out in the sprint and first in the race. A performance worth applauding. Grade *nine*.

finale.domanda: What grade would you give Qatar?
